notes.title: Anomie fans, see here!
notes.notes:
Hello, Leaf here!

I wasn't even aware there was so many members in this group! What a nice surprise. So... I'm here because I'm bringing news.

We're currently working on our second title, which has been titled "Winter's Symphonies". It's a bit different than Anomie in more than one way, but we're set on making it another great story. A Kickstarter campaign for the project is currently live here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/toneyemedia/winters-symphonies-a-visual-novel

If you feel like checking it out, let me know what you think!

Thanks for showing interest in our games!
